You see a pick.
It weighs 45.00 oz.

Notes

Picks are used to open holes in unusual places, such as random squares of mud. It can also sometimes destroy stones or use it to open fishing holes in ice. For a list of known places where you can open a hole with a pick, take a look here: List of Pickeable Holes.

All of the three Secret Agent Tools can be used as a pick.
Needed in a mission of The Ice Islands Quest.
Needed in a mission of Kissing a Pig Quest.
Needed in a mission of Opticording Sphere Quest.
Item obtainable in the Small Axe Quest and The Rookie Guard Quest.
Needed to obtain Key 4601 in Rookgaard.
